decisions.summary: Accepted: strict test-path guard is an intentional hard-fail contract break with no override flag
decisions.reason: Owner sato_keigo approved on 2026-07-31 (Claude Code session 70ea817c-ee56-48c0-ab7c-612da8629872; transcript ~/.claude/projects/-Users-ksato-workspace-repos-vibepro/70ea817c-ee56-48c0-ab7c-612da8629872.jsonl) that the process-improvement PRs #400/#401/#402 may apply owner waivers to close gates, on the explicit condition that CI must be green. This record is written by the closure agent as a RELAYED receipt of that approval; the closure agent did not observe the owner prompt first-hand. CI is green on the current HEAD 5a0e056a (CodeQL, analyze, test (20), test (22) all pass) and is not waived. Item content: the independent judge flagged that this makes previously-accepted 'verify record' input hard-fail with no override flag, and that a command whose test paths are relative to a subpackage cwd rather than repo root would be rejected with no escape hatch. Accepted as intended behavior: the whole purpose of this Story is to stop false-green evidence from being recorded, and an override flag would reintroduce exactly the hole being closed. The failure direction is fail-closed (a blocked recording, never a false green), and the guard is scoped to tokens ending in .test.*/.spec.* so the blast radius is bounded. If a downstream subpackage-relative usage actually surfaces, it is a follow-up Story, not a reason to ship an escape hatch now.
